items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And T. Shan was the president. And T. Shan died. Remember Vic T. Shan?

ctx.x: Well I mean how do you do that?

Well you see, you know fellas in the club. Then you know something is going on. Then you get next to the chairman and he said bring the bid in, bring your bid in, he'd tell you the time, you know, the hours. Then you'd get in there and you'd beat the other guy, the other guy, well they wouldn't even recognize the other fella, they want you. And that's where you would, that's where you would, I'd get the wood. You take like the Square Deal, I had the Square Deal boys sold up. They had a wonderful club there. They…
Yeah, he used to work on Bourbon Street, didn't he? Yeah. That's right. Now he was a good bass drum player too. I didn't know that.
